reports.rendered_content: Test suite verifies floor triangle index building, memory bounds (indices >100k, packed bytes <3MB), acceleration raycasting, and projection coverage optimization in both fixed-first and joint-pair modes. Fixed mode uses origin [2.5, 1.6, 2.5]; both modes produce 256 samples, >2 candidates, finite origins, origin separation >=4, and reachableCoverage >= combinedCoverage.
